scientific_integrity: The proof uses Tornes's exact all-powers construction, a normalized completely bounded norming sequence, uniform coordinate bounds, and a block-diagonal direct sum. No numerical experiment or unproved compactness assertion is used.
scientific_limitations: The witness is separable and generally infinite-dimensional; no finite-level attainment of the completely bounded norm is claimed. The witness depends on the ordered pair of operator-space structures through a norming sequence.
title: A single operator tuple attains completely bounded distortion through Shalit–Shamovich radii
